primaryChecks.text: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

primaryChecks.text: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
